label: Hopeful
acknowledgment: Hope is not optimism. The Quran speaks of it as confidence. These words have lifted hearts for 1400 years. They are here for you today.

verses.translation_en: Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
verses.context: Addressed to those who have transgressed against themselves. Mercy is for everyone, not just the perfect.

verses.translation_en: For indeed, with hardship comes ease.
verses.context: Ease is placed with hardship, not after it. They are intertwined.

verses.translation_en: And do not despair of the relief of Allah.
verses.context: Spoken by Yaqub after losing Yusuf for years. His words were still hope.

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا
verses.translation_en: And whoever fears Allah, He will make for him a way out.
verses.context: The way out is not described. It is left open. The verse promises a way, not the shape of it.

verses.translation_en: Unquestionably, the help of Allah is near.
verses.context: Comes after a description of tests, answering the question: when will help come?

verses.translation_en: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
verses.context: The giving is promised, and the satisfaction is included.

verses.translation_en: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first.
verses.context: The present is placed within a longer view.

verses.translation_en: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
verses.context: The present is passing. What is with Allah is lasting.

verses.translation_en: And what is with Allah is better and more lasting.
verses.context: What is with Allah is better and more lasting than the present.

verses.translation_en: Call upon Me; I will respond to you.
verses.context: The response is promised. The form it takes is not always what we expect.

names_of_allah.explanation: His mercy is not a reward for the deserving. It is the air you are already breathing. It does not run out.

evidence_verses.translation_en: The Most Compassionate, taught the Quran.
Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.

names_of_allah.explanation: He opens what is closed. Doors, hearts, paths. What seems sealed can be opened by Him.

evidence_verses.arabic: رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ
evidence_verses.translation_en: Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth.

evidence_verses.arabic: مَّا يَفْتَحِ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا
evidence_verses.translation_en: Whatever Allah grants to people of mercy, none can withhold it.

names_of_allah.explanation: He responds. Not always in the way we expect. Not always in the time we choose. But He responds.

evidence_verses.translation_en: Indeed, my Lord is Near and Responsive.
Call upon Me; I will respond to you.

names_of_allah.explanation: He is closer than your own jugular vein. Closeness is stated without condition, without distance, without delay.

evidence_verses.arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ
evidence_verses.translation_en: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near.

evidence_verses.arabic: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ
evidence_verses.translation_en: And We are closer to him than his jugular vein.

names_of_allah.explanation: He preserves what you cannot protect. Your peace, your future, your loved ones. Nothing is lost with Him.

evidence_verses.arabic: إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَفِيظٌ
evidence_verses.translation_en: Indeed, my Lord is, over all things, a Preserver.
And your Lord is, over all things, a Preserver.

personal_question: What are you hoping for today? Have you asked Allah for it?
